app.name: Vedit
steps.label: Steps
menu.label: Account and settings
home.title: What are you making?
home.tiles.label: Project types
home.tile.clip.title: Clip a long video
home.tile.clip.desc: Find the best 20 to 90 second moments in a podcast, stream or interview, crop them to vertical and add captions.
home.tile.vlog.title: Edit a vlog
home.tile.vlog.desc: Cut dead air, filler words and retakes, then add chapters and captions.
home.tile.reel.title: Quick Reel / Short
home.tile.reel.desc: Turn one phone video into a fast 9:16 cut with pop-up captions.
home.tile.photos.title: Photos + script → Reel
home.tile.photos.desc: Combine photos and clips with your script, then add voices, title cards and subtitles.
home.tile.batch.title: Batch & automate
home.tile.batch.desc: Apply a saved template to many inputs, like a daily fact Reel for your Facebook page.
home.recent.title: Recent projects
home.recent.empty: No projects yet. Clips you make will show up here.
home.recent.error: Recent projects aren't available right now.
import.title: Import a video
import.drop.label: Video file
import.drop.title: Drop a video here
import.drop.formats: MP4, MOV, M4V, MKV, AVI, WebM, MTS or 3GP
import.next.pick: You pick the clips to keep
import.unsupported: This file isn't a video Vedit can open. Try an MP4 or MOV file.
import.cancelled.hint: The analysis was stopped. Press Start to run it again.
import.failed.title: Analysis didn't finish
import.failed.generic: Something went wrong while analyzing this video.
pick.title: Pick clips
pick.more.full: You have the most clips Vedit can find ({n}).
pick.more.none: No more clips found in this video.
pick.empty: No speech found in this video. Vedit finds clips from what people say.
pick.error.keep: Couldn't save that change. Check that Vedit is still running, then try again.
pick.error.more: Couldn't look for more clips. Try again in a moment.
player.label: Video preview
player.error: This video can't be previewed. You can still export it.
player.note.look: Music and color are applied on export.
player.note.bumpers: Intro and outro are added on export.
pick.error.reload: Couldn't load the new clips. Reopen this project to see them.
edit.title: Edit
edit.error.keep: Couldn't save that change. Check that Vedit is still running, then try again.
edit.error.save: Couldn't save the last edit, so it was undone: {msg}
edit.error.load: Couldn't load this clip. Check that Vedit is still running, then try again.
edit.error.transcript: Couldn't load the transcript, so words, captions and the timeline can't be shown. Try again in a moment.
edit.error.ranges: This clip's edit doesn't match its transcript, so the timeline can't be placed: {msg}
edit.tx.hint: Click a word to cut it or fix its spelling. Shift-click to pick several. Crossed-out words are already removed.
edit.tx.speaker: Speaker {n}
edit.tx.fix.label: Correct spelling
edit.tx.fix.hint: Enter to save, Esc to cancel
edit.tl.label: Timeline
edit.tl.select.title: Select a piece or layer
edit.tl.undo.title: Undo (Ctrl+Z)
edit.tl.redo.title: Redo (Ctrl+Shift+Z)
edit.tl.duplicate.title: Duplicate the selected layer (Ctrl+D)
edit.tl.split.title: Split at the playhead (S)
edit.tl.delete.title: Delete the selected piece (Delete)
edit.tl.delete.layer.title: Delete the selected layer (Delete)
edit.tl.trim.title: Trim ends: drag a clip edge
edit.tl.ov.label: {what}. Drag to move, drag an edge to change its length
edit.tl.ov.hint: Drag to move. Drag an edge to change its length. Arrow keys nudge it, Alt + arrows change its length
edit.tl.zoom.out.title: Zoom out (-)
edit.tl.zoom.in.title: Zoom in (+)
edit.tl.zoom.fit.title: Show the whole clip
signin.show: Long videos in. Ready-to-post Reels, Shorts and TikToks out.
signin.title: Sign in to Vedit
signup.title: Create your Vedit account
signup.name: Name
signin.modes: Sign in or create an account
auth.error.not_configured: Accounts aren't connected in this build yet. Choose Skip for now to keep working.
auth.error.invalid_email: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
auth.error.weak_password: Use a password with at least {n} characters.
auth.error.wrong_password: That email and password don't match an account.
auth.error.email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
auth.error.no_account: No account uses this email. Create one instead.
auth.error.check_email: Check your inbox: open the link we sent to confirm your email, then sign in.
auth.error.rate_limited: Too many tries in a row. Wait a minute, then try again.
auth.error.network: Can't reach the account service. Check your internet connection and try again.
auth.error.social_cancelled: Sign in was cancelled. Pick a way to sign in to try again.
auth.error.social_failed: That sign in didn't go through. Try again, or use your email.
auth.error.social_unavailable: Google and Facebook sign in come with the installer. Use your email for now.
auth.error.unknown: Something went wrong signing in. Try again.
settings.title: Settings
settings.output.browser: Choosing a folder works in the installed app.
settings.ai.note: Optional. Only the transcript text is sent, never your video.
settings.ai.err.rejected: The provider did not accept this key.
settings.ai.err.network: Could not reach the provider. Check your internet connection.
settings.ai.err.engine: The engine is not running, so the key could not be tested.
settings.ai.err.store: The key could not be saved or read.
settings.models.note: Models are used on this computer to turn speech into text.
settings.models.error: Could not read the models. The engine may not be running.
settings.model.busy: A job is running. Try again when it finishes.
settings.brand.note: Applied to clips made after you save.
settings.brand.error: The brand kit could not be saved.
settings.brand.loaderror: Could not read the brand kit. The engine may not be running.
settings.updates.browser: Updates come with the installed app.
settings.updates.error: Could not check for updates. Try again later.
export.title: Export
export.missing: This project could not be found.
export.none: No clips are kept yet. Pick the clips you want to export first.
export.quality.hint: High makes bigger files and takes longer.
export.folder.browser: Choosing a folder works in the installed app.
export.error.start: Could not start the export. Check that the engine is running and try again.
export.show.browser: Showing files in a folder works in the installed app.
export.busy: An export of this video is still running. You can start another when it finishes or is cancelled.
export.row.thumbwarn: The video is saved, but the thumbnail could not be.
edit.ly.len: Lasts {n} s. Drag its edges on the timeline to change that.
edit.ly.text.empty: Text shows over the video for as long as its block on the timeline. Drag the block to move it.
edit.ly.broll.empty: B-roll is a photo or video shown over the clip, full screen or in a corner, at the playhead.
edit.color.hint: Sharpen shows in the export only.
edit.speed.hint: Voices keep their pitch. Captions and layers stay on their words.
topbar.demo.title: This demo plays a sample clip, not your videos. To edit your own, start the real app: VEDIT_DEV_ENGINE=1 npm run tauri dev
edit.frame.zoom.soft: This video has no pixels to spare at this shape, so any zoom makes it softer. Automatic punch-ins are left out to keep it sharp.
edit.frame.zoom.sharp: Stays sharp up to {n}×. Automatic punch-ins stop there.
edit.frame.zoom.over: Past {n}× this video starts to look soft.
